Automatically publish content to WordPress and other supported CMS platforms
Schedule recurring content campaigns for ongoing SEO automation

system.title: 4.1 Credit System
system.description: The Service operates on a credit-based system. Each usage operation consumes credits based on the selected AI model, article length, and features used. Credit costs are displayed before you confirm a generation.

free.title: 4.2 Trial Credits
free.description: New users may receive trial credits upon registration. Trial credits are subject to expiry and may be modified or discontinued at any time without notice.

subscription.title: 4.3 Subscription Credits

refunds.title: 4.4 Refunds and Failed Generations
refunds.intro: Credits are generally non-refundable once used. However:
reasons: Credits consumed by a failed usage operation are automatically refunded to your account
Duplicate charges due to billing errors may be refunded upon request
Refund requests for other reasons are evaluated at our sole discretion

terms: Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each billing period unless cancelled
